best_parts: node hook_t1: names the tempting reason ('indirect is the commonest, so the safe pick'), refutes by the deep-ring route, and gives a sure_note on a confident error
node hook_route: a second, route-first explanation offered as an agency step after a miss
node fem_t_bm / position_t40: each TR40 feedback names the copied inguinal position and states both positions
flaws: node hook: the stem restates the definition ('comes through the posterior wall ... medial to the vessels'), so the key can be matched by keyword and the probe tests less than it claims
node sex: the probe has one trap (Femoral) and no second TR5 distractor, so a 2-option probe with a single wrong model diagnoses little
segment-level: TR1 is tested once and TR5 once in S1 with no re-test in a different form, and no exam-style 'relatively more common' statement is drilled here

best_parts: node hook: the stem gives only the lateral position, so the learner must map lateral-to-vessels to indirect; the key is not restated and the trap 'Direct' is the swap error
node tim_probe: exam-form statement with the qualifier 'relatively' carrying the trap, with TR5 'femoral leads' and the female-skew reading as distractors; tim_explain then explains the qualifier
node explain_route plus deep_ring: 'Go deeper' agency node linking the deep ring to 1.25 cm above the midinguinal point (K5), a natural second layer
flaws: node hook: the 'Femoral' option is dominated for a learner who is guessing between the two inguinal types, so it adds little discrimination here
node retest_route: re-tests TR1 with the same recognition form as hook (vessel side plus posterior wall), so the retest is not in a different form and its stem restates the answer's route
node hook_t40: the feedback says 'the vessel test sorts the two inguinal types' and then places femoral, which blurs the inguinal versus femoral distinction it is meant to draw

best_parts: node gate_ok: an explicit fast lane ('I have it, skip the route lesson') that still covers O1 through the probe and feedback, so the expertise reversal is handled
node pos_why and most_why: a side-by-side contrast explanation (above and medial versus below and lateral; 'relatively' versus 'most') offered after a miss, a genuinely different second explanation
node contrast: exam-form statement probe re-testing TR5 in a different form from the most-common probe, with feedback that names the ranking-versus-comparison model
flaws: node gate: the stem restates the definition ('comes through the posterior wall ... medial to the inferior epigastric vessels'), so the probe is matchable by keyword and its first wrong option is less diagnostic
node most_t5b and contrast_t5b: 'Direct' is labelled TR5 but the trap map treats it as a partial, and it is easy to rule out, so it is dominated rather than a TR5 trap
node gate_t1: the feedback names the route but the retry goes straight back to the same stem, with no changed form before the re-test

merge_ideas: b's lateral-stem hook and tim_probe exam statement with c's skip fast lane at gate_ok and c's pos_why side-by-side explanation after a TR40 miss
c's contrast statement probe re-testing TR5 added to b's flow, so TR5 gets two forms as well as the female-skew distractor
a's hook_t1 wording (tempting reason, then route, then sure_note) written into b's hook so the trap feedback keeps its sure_note
